lines.note: Combines paying vows and the precious death of the saints. The second Greek verse labelled 4 is treated as verse 5. Greek 5 is the verse GRCBRENT serves as a second 4 (PRB-0972); accepted by the lead after reading.
Greek 7 is split between Ge'ez 6 and 7; Ge'ez 7 continues with Greek 8 and repeats the invocation of the Lord's name.
Combines paying vows before the people with the courts of the Lord's house in Jerusalem.
